sentences.ko: 친척 중에 그 레시피 갖고 있는 사람 혹시 없어?
sentences.text: Isn't there any relative that would have the recipe?

alts.text: Would any of your relatives happen to have the recipe?

sentences.note: **Isn't there any** ~? 는 '혹시 ~ 없어?' 하고 기대를 걸며 묻는 말이에요. 잃어버린 것, 구할 방법을 찾을 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 우리가 뭐 해 줄 수 있는 거 없어요?
sentences.text: Is there anything we can do for you?

alts.text: Please let us know if there is anything we can do for you.

sentences.note: **anything we can do** 는 힘든 일을 겪는 사람에게 도울 게 있는지 물을 때 쓰는 말이에요. 가게 직원이 손님에게 물을 때도 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아무튼, 걔가 식당을 차리는데 주방장을 구하고 있대.
sentences.text: Anyway, um he's opening up a restaurant and he's looking for a head chef.

alts.text: So he's starting a restaurant and needs a head chef.
In any case, he is opening a restaurant and is seeking a head chef.

sentences.note: **opening up a restaurant** 는 '식당을 차리다'예요. 말 앞의 **Anyway** 는 딴 얘기를 하다가 본론으로 돌아올 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아 진짜, 고양이 때문에 눈물이 줄줄 나.
sentences.text: Oh my god, the cat's made my eyes water.

alts.text: Ugh, this cat's got my eyes all watery.
I am afraid the cat has made my eyes water.

sentences.note: **made my eyes water**는 알레르기가 있거나 매운 걸 먹었거나 연기를 쐬어서 눈물이 날 때 써요. 슬퍼서 우는 게 아니라 눈에서 저절로 눈물이 날 때 하는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 왠지 네가 엄마가 된 모습은 잘 상상이 안 돼.
sentences.text: I I just don't see you as a mom, somehow.

alts.text: Can't really picture you as a mom.
For some reason, I cannot quite see you as a mother.

sentences.note: **see you as**는 '너를 ~로 여기다, ~인 모습을 그려 보다'라는 뜻이에요. 끝에 붙은 **somehow**는 '이유는 모르겠지만 왠지'라는 느낌을 더해서 말을 부드럽게 해 줘요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 넌 그냥 해야 할 일을 한 거야.
sentences.text: You just did what you had to do.

alts.text: Hey, you did what you needed to.
It was simply what you needed to do.

sentences.note: **did what you had to do**는 힘든 결정을 내린 친구를 다독일 때 쓰는 말이에요. '네 잘못 아니야, 어쩔 수 없었잖아'라는 위로가 담겨 있어요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.text: I mean, there's got to be an explanation.

alts.text: Surely there must be an explanation for this.

sentences.note: **there's got to be**는 '분명 ~가 있을 거야'라고 확신할 때 써요. 이상한 일이 생겨서 이해가 안 될 때 자주 나오는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.text: No, I think it's very obvious who's wrong here.

alts.text: Come on, it's pretty clear who messed up.
In my view, it is quite clear which one of you is in the wrong.

sentences.note: **who's wrong here**는 말다툼에서 누가 잘못했는지 따질 때 써요. **in the wrong**은 '잘못한 쪽'이라는 뜻으로, 조금 더 격식을 갖춘 표현이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
